scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web "npm run dev --workspace apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/contracts && npm run build --workspace packages/domain && npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts apps/**/*.{ts,tsx,json,css,html} packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,json,css,html} e2e/**/*.{ts,tsx}
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts apps/**/*.{ts,tsx,json,css,html} packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,json,css,html} e2e/**/*.{ts,tsx}
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
